title: STRIFF 2-in-1 Laptop and Mobile Stand, Ergonomic, Adjustable Height, Anti-Slip Base, Heat Dissipation, Portable, Lightweight, Compatible with All Laptops Up to 15.6" (Abs, Black)
bullets: 【Customizable Ergonomic Heights】Adjustable 8-level height (5.5" to 7.0") aligns your screen to eye level, reducing neck strain during long work hours. Ideal for office tasks, gaming, or video calls—maintain a healthy posture effortlessly.

【Sturdy & Lightweight Design】Crafted from aircraft-grade ABS + non-slip silicone pads, this stand securely holds 10-17” laptops and tablets without wobbling. The matte finish resists scratches and fits MacBook Pro 16", Dell XPS 17, and gaming laptops.

【Portable & Space-Saving】Folds flat to 0.6" thickness—slips into backpacks or drawers. Use it on cramped desks, coffee shops, or beds. The built-in phone holder creates a dual-screen workstation for multitasking.

【360° Rotation & Team Collaboration】Smooth rotating base lets you share screens in meetings or switch between portrait/landscape modes. The side phone slot keeps notifications visible without interrupting workflow.

【Heat Dissipation & Universal Compatibility】Hollow airflow design prevents overheating during intensive tasks. Compatible with all 10-17” laptops, tablets, and phones—including HP Spectre, iPad Pro, and ASUS ROG.
